name: Merges and deploys held for your yes
what: A set of rules you can switch on holds each merge into a default branch and each deploy for your answer. If the hold's limit passes first, it is refused as held and not answered. You can answer in Silo's phone app.

suggest.why: A merge into the default branch and a deploy are the two actions people most want a say in, and a set that ships with Silo saves writing those rules.
